name: chat-message
purpose: One message in a generative AI conversation (Cloudscape's chat bubble, AI Elements' Message): who wrote it (avatar and author line), the content, and — once the response is complete — the inline actions a reader takes on it (copy, regenerate, thumbs up / down). It owns the message lifecycle: `pending` (waiting for the first token: the loading text), `streaming` (content arriving, busy, no actions), `complete` (actions shown; announced once to screen readers through the `Conversation`) and `error` (an error line with Try again). User messages sit in a filled bubble; assistant messages are flat, full width, beside the assistant mark; system messages are a muted centered line. Alignment comes from the enclosing `Conversation`.
useWhen: Every turn of a chat with the generative AI assistant: the person's prompt, the assistant's response, a system note ("Conversation restarted").
A response that must show its lifecycle (loading, streaming, failure) and its actions.
avoidWhen: A generated block outside a conversation (a summary on a page) → `StreamingResponse` alone.
A notification or toast about the product → `alert` / `toast`.
A comment thread between people → not this component; it carries AI semantics (feedback thumbs, regenerate).
related: conversation` — the log that holds messages, sets alignment and announces finished ones.
streaming-response` — the safe Markdown renderer for assistant content.
reasoning`, `sources`, `tool-call`, `artifact-preview` — parts that stack inside an assistant message.
bestPractices: Pass `state` from your request: `pending` until the first token, `streaming` while tokens arrive, then `complete` or `error`.
Keep actions to five or fewer, always visible (no hover-only): copy, regenerate, feedback.
Use `grouped` for a second message by the same author so stacked bubbles read as one turn (only the first shows the avatar).
Never put the feedback thumbs on non-AI content.

props.name: from
props.doc: Who wrote the message: the person (`user`), the generative AI assistant, or the product (`system`).

props.name: author
props.doc: Author name shown over the message and read in its accessible name. Empty uses the locale catalog (`You`, `AI assistant`, `System`).

props.name: timestamp
props.doc: Time the message was sent, already formatted for display (`10:42`). Added to the accessible name.

props.name: state
props.doc: Lifecycle: `pending` shows the loading text, `streaming` marks the content busy, `complete` shows the actions, `error` shows the error line with Try again.

props.name: grouped
props.doc: Follows a message by the same author: drops the avatar and the author line so stacked messages read as one turn.

props.name: errorMessage
props.doc: Error text shown while `state` is `error`. Empty uses the locale catalog.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.doc: Loading text shown while `state` is `pending`. Empty uses `AiLoading`'s own (`Generating a response`).

slots.name: default
slots.notes: The content: text, `StreamingResponse`, `Reasoning`, `Sources`, artifacts. Not rendered while `pending`.

slots.name: avatar
slots.notes: Replaces the default avatar (person glyph for the user, the assistant mark for the AI).

slots.name: actions
slots.notes: Inline actions, usually `ChatMessage.Actions`; shown only when `state` is `complete`.
